name: gmdtool Runtime Bridge
description: Opt-in localhost runtime bridge with optional GitHub Releases auto-updates. Does not force gameplay or focus.

enabled.name: Enable local API (restart required)
enabled.description: Start a 127.0.0.1 server on port 18731 for Python gmdtool.

auto-update.name: Check for updates automatically
auto-update.description: At the main menu, check GitHub Releases, download and verify a newer mod, and offer Restart. Requires public releases.
